process CPC2 {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_single'
    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/cpc2:1.0.1--hdfd78af_1':
        'quay.io/biocontainers/cpc2:1.0.1--hdfd78af_1' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(fasta)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.txt"), emit: txt
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('CPC2'), eval("CPC2.py --version"), topic: versions, emit: versions_cpc2

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"

    """
    CPC2.py \\
       -i ${fasta} \\
       -o ${prefix} \\
    $args
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"

    """
    echo $args
    touch ${prefix}.txt
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/cpc2"
description: "Coding Potential Calculator 2"
keywords:
- "coding potential"
- "genomics"
- "transcriptomics"
tools:
- cpc2:
    description: "Coding Potential Calculator 2 (CPC2)"
    homepage: "https://github.com/gao-lab/CPC2_standalone"
    documentation: "https://github.com/gao-lab/CPC2_standalone"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/gao-lab/CPC2_standalone"
    doi: "10.1093/nar/gkx428"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:cpc2"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information. e.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`"
  - fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "Input FASTA file containing nucleotide sequences"
      pattern: "*.{fasta,fa}"
      ontologies:
      - EDAM: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
output:
  txt:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information e.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`"
    - '*.txt':
        type: "file"
        description: "CPC2 output file"
        pattern: "*.{txt}"
        ontologies: []
  versions_cpc2:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - CPC2:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - CPC2.py --version:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - CPC2:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - CPC2.py --version:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@razmia02"
maintainers:
- "@razmia02"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
